exposure: Maternal depression (EPDS-10) during first and third trimesters
Maternal anxiety (EPDS-3A) during first and third trimesters
cohort: The study included 271 mother-infant pairs derived from the Finnish Kuopio Birth Cohort Study.
finding: Maternal anxiety during the third trimester (T3 EPDS-3A) was linked to reduced neonatal hair cortisol levels, while maternal depression (T1 and T3 EPDS-10) and T1 maternal anxiety did not predict neonatal hair steroid levels.
